demographics.family_situation: Typically single or in early-stage relationships, with no dependents

social_class.description: Lower-middle class, likely earning between 1,000 and 2,000 EUR/month

lifestyle_and_habits: Financially cautious, prefers to rely on a single, straightforward credit product
Shows high levels of trust and satisfaction with their financial provider
Values responsible financial management but is still developing long-term financial strategies
Likely tech-savvy and uses digital channels for financial interactions
motivations: Wants a strong, reliable relationship with a financial provider
Seeks fair treatment and transparency in lending practices
Appreciates personalized and dependable service that supports their financial goals
frustrations: May feel that lending practices could be more responsible or tailored to individual needs
Wants deeper engagement and stronger recognition from their financial provider
Occasionally perceives room for improvement in feeling fairly treated by institutions
nps_baseline: High promoter group — mean score of 9.3, with 82% promoters and very few detractors
credit_context: Holds a single personal loan and has minimal engagement with other financial products
